asks: How long has this building been up?
Is there a window in here?
description: A young tree has come up through the floor here, tiles shouldered aside in a neat ring, and it is going about its business as if it had been given permission.
emotes: {it} puts out a leaf while you are watching, which takes about four seconds.
A tile lifts and cracks somewhere near the base of {it}.
{it} turns very slightly towards the nearest light.
looks: It has gone through concrete the way a thought goes through a mood.
Where it has been longest, the floor has agreed with it and closed round the trunk.
It has no opinion about you at all, which is a relief.
name: a tree coming up through the floor
says: I was doing this before you came.
Do not be alarmed. I would not know how.
